name: 金刚三昧院多宝塔
checkpoints: TWO roof levels, three-bay square lower body, white rounded dome between roofs and round upper timber cylinder.
Hinoki-bark roofs with curved eaves, tall nine-ring finial, low front veranda, a central pair of doors between slatted windows.
Preserve the three-bay scale; no five-bay Daito, neighboring buildings, trees or foreground stone lantern.
